answer: Why an embed goes from 8 to 6 rows after a short snippet: its placeholder is 95 tall, a short snippet 22.4, and a fall in content height gives rows up. One line 8 to 6, two lines 8 to 7, 3, 4 and 6 lines stay at 8, 8 lines 9, 10 lines 10, 14 lines 14. The same snippet again changes nothing, so the earlier 6 then 4 came from passing through empty, back to the placeholder. An embed's content needs about 32 more than its box reads, likely its paragraph margins: rows = ceil((height + 41) / 41.1) fits these, inferred. Its editor is the older kind and has no Expand.
